_metadata.description: What Unit Health owns and explicitly does not own, and how it resolves a target scenario.

requirements.title: Resolve a target scenario for test validation
requirements.description: ValidateScenario resolves a scenario by id or path and returns a degraded (non-passing) assessment when the target cannot be resolved or has no discoverable test surface, never a silent pass.

validation.notes: Tests prove unknown scenario and empty scenario both yield explicit L0 findings, not a clean pass.

requirements.title: Exclude shell, smoke, playbooks, and global maturity
requirements.description: Unit Health does not perform shell syntax validation (Quality Health owns it), does not run smoke/playbooks/E2E (BAS owns them), and never reports final global scenario maturity (maturity-go owns it) — it emits only local maturity and semantic global impacts.

validation.notes: No shell planning is produced; assessment exposes local maturity + global impacts but no overall scenario rung.
